# Covenant Earth Works

> Owner-operated earthworks, road construction and site preparation contractor based in Red Deer, Alberta, Canada. Serving Red Deer, Rocky View County, Red Deer County, Calgary and Calgary metro.

Covenant Earth Works is an earthworks and road construction business founded and operated by **Barry Porter**, who has **25 years of experience across the construction and logging industries** — 20 years in construction, and 5 years working with logging equipment, demolition, grading and operations. Barry owns the fleet outright: **25 construction machines and 20 logging machines** (45 total), maintained in-house.

## What we do

**Heavy road and earthworks**
- Road construction and gravel roads — subgrade, base course, road prism, shoulder pull-back
- Mass earthmoving and site balancing — cut and fill, stockpiles, haul and place
- Industrial pads and hardstands
- Bulk clearing and grubbing
- Subgrade and base compaction with GPS / machine-control grading
- Lease roads and access

**Residential and commercial site work**
- Site preparation and rough grade
- Final and fine grading
- Driveways, approaches and culverts
- Drainage and water management — swales, catch basins, retention
- Trenching and underground preparation
- Pond and watercourse excavation

**Not offered:** concrete, asphalt, building construction, utility installation, land reclamation.

## Ground conditions we work in

Central Alberta. Clay soils that hold water and shrink when dry. Freeze–thaw cycles that fail roads in spring rather than summer. Organic topsoil worth more than the mineral soil beneath it. We plan around these conditions rather than despite them.

## Credentials

- COR certified (Certificate of Recognition via ACSA)
- WCB Alberta covered
- ISNetworld registered

## Service area

Red Deer, Rocky View County, Red Deer County, Calgary and Calgary metro including Okotoks, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, High River and Black Diamond, plus Blackfalds, Sylvan Lake, Clive, Delburne, Caroline, Lacombe, Ponoka, Innisfail and Red Bluff. Travel beyond these areas on request.
